title: Zone 2 endurance run
summary: Conversational-pace run that builds aerobic base.
steps: 5-min walking warm-up at 5 km/h.
25 min steady run holding a heart rate of ~70% max.
5-min walking cool-down + light stretching.

title: Hill intervals · 6×400m
summary: Short hills with full recovery — leg power + VO2.
steps: 10-min warm-up jog flat.
6 rounds: 90s at 6% incline, 8.5–9 km/h. 90s walking flat.
5-min cool-down.

title: 2k row time trial
steps: Warm-up 5 min easy.
Row 2,000 m as fast as sustainable.
Cool-down 5 min light row.

title: Back squat · 5×5
summary: Classic strength lift for total-body size and force.
steps: Bar warm-up: 2×8 empty bar, then ramp to working weight.
5 sets × 5 reps at ~80% 1RM, 2–3 min rest between sets.
Mobility: hip flexors + thoracic extension.

title: Overhead press · 3×8
steps: Warm-up: 2×8 empty bar, 1×5 with 50% working weight.
3 sets × 8 reps at ~70% 1RM.
Finish: face-pulls or band pull-aparts 2×15.

title: Bench press · 3×10
summary: Hypertrophy-rep range bench for chest and triceps.
steps: Warm-up: 2×10 empty bar, 1×8 with 50% working weight.
3 sets × 10 reps with controlled tempo.
Optional: dumbbell flys 2×12.

title: Single-arm DB row
steps: Knee + opposite hand on bench, back flat.
3 sets × 10 reps each side, full range of motion.
Light stretch for posterior shoulder.

title: Lat pulldown · 4×10
summary: Vertical pulling, alternative to chin-ups while you build up.
steps: Set seat so knees fit snug under pads.
4 sets × 10 reps, pull to upper chest, 1.5 min rest.
Optional: face pulls 3×15 for rear delts.

title: Face pulls · 3×15
steps: Rope attachment at upper-chest height.
3 sets × 15 reps, pull rope toward forehead, elbows high.
Squeeze 1 second on each rep.

title: Leg press · 4×12
summary: Lower-body volume in a back-friendly position.
steps: Foot placement mid-platform, shoulder width.
4 sets × 12 reps, control on the way down.
Keep lower back glued to the pad.

title: Bodyweight squat
summary: Foundational lower-body exercise — no equipment needed.
steps: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
3 sets × 15 reps, controlled descent.
Heels on the ground throughout.

title: Push-ups · 3×10
summary: Classic pushing pattern for upper body.
steps: Hands shoulder-width, body in a straight line.
3 sets × 10 reps, slow descent, push to lockout.
Knee push-ups are a great regression.
